spec_match.rationale: Demonstrates the new gate precisely as specified: setAppBadge/clearAppBadge remain resolve-quietly APIs, and on attributed macOS apps the badge additionally requires granted notification permission — the page pairs every real call with the live permission state so the silent gate becomes legible.

interactive.rationale: Number input + three real API calls with timed promise outcomes; permission requestable; the gate-consequence cell recomputes from display-mode + permission live.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises real calls, real outcomes, live permission readout; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Four-context consequence matrix (API absent / tab / installed+granted / installed+gated) each stated honestly; rejections surfaced with names; the page repeatedly warns that resolution never proves rendering — the deliberate unobservability IS the lesson.

references.rationale: Feature index cites the chromestatus entry, Badging spec, and the enterprise policy pairing.

conformance.rationale: The suite's badging-surface, settling-promises, and permission-queryable assertions distil this page; all six suite checks pass live on this engine (screenshot evidence).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: setAppBadge(3) and clearAppBadge() genuinely called and RESOLVED in 0.2ms each with the correct browser-tab consequence displayed; live permission cell read 'prompt'; conformance panel showed 6 pass / 0 fail. Zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: notifattr-badge-called asserts per call with the permission state.

design_system.rationale: Gate cells on paper, emerald/rose permission states (AA on paper), mono outputs on stone; CSS variables only; 44px inputs.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled count input; call outcomes in a role=status live region; permission state textual with colour as reinforcement only.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Gate grid collapses under 720px; buttons wrap; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Demonstrate the gate closing on a real macOS install
openQuestions.detail: The decisive run needs macOS: installed app, permission denied → setAppBadge resolves yet no dock badge; then grant → badge appears. Capture both sides to complete the gate evidence.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Treat silent-by-design APIs honestly; never infer success from resolution.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every outcome message explicitly decouples promise resolution from badge rendering.

guidanceConsulted.query: live announcement of derived output on input
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Outcome and permission cells are live regions with full detail.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): real Badging calls resolved in 0.2ms with the correct tab-context consequence shown, the live permission cell tracked the Permissions API, and the page's core teaching — resolution never proves a badge — is enforced in every message. The macOS gate-closing run is the recorded open question.
